creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-29: "confirm on CMD w for agents". At triage on 2026-11-01 he settled the shape: ⌘W asks before closing a pane that runs an agent, and Return confirms. A pane running a plain shell keeps closing at once.

⌘W is `close_pane` (`docs/configuration.md`), and `MusterWindow.closePane` (`Sources/MusterMac/MusterWindow.swift:1388`) sends the close at once, ending the agent with it. a_2luwIMCjM makes ⌘Q ask in the same way.

Return confirming reverses a rule `ConfirmSheet` states on purpose (`Sources/MusterMac/ConfirmSheet.swift`, since cf762585): Return is not bound to the confirming button, because the sheet exists to interrupt a reflexive keystroke. That rule was written for Quit and Close Sessions, which ends every agent on every machine. This card and the Return card for Delete Group need a per-call choice in `ConfirmSheet`, with its doc comment rewritten to say which questions take Return and why. Open: whether the right-click Close Pane and the menu item ask too, or only the chord.
title: ⌘W asks before closing a pane that runs an agent, and Return confirms
